exposure: Care received at private Chiranjeevi Yojana (CY) facilities
outcome: Women's perceptions of quality of care
cohort: 30 mothers who had birthed in 10 private Chiranjeevi Yojana facilities within the last month.
finding: Mothers' experiences during birth are more accurate indicators of the quality of care received than their reported satisfaction at discharge, with a 'good delivery' primarily defined by being 'saved' and secondarily by factors like vaginal birth, male child, short pain, and free of charge.
mod_finding: Giving birth vaginally was a commonly agreed upon characteristic of a 'good (sari) delivery'.
followup_time: Within the last month after birth
cross-section timing: Within the last month after birth
